//ForwardedHeaders: Which upstream proxies may set X-Forwarded-For/-Proto. Only addresses listed here are
trusted; every other peer keeps its socket address, so a forged header from a client is
ignored. Both rate limiters partition on the resulting client IP, so this list is a
security boundary, not just a logging nicety. Empty = loopback only (ASP.NET default).
Set the reverse proxy's network here -- see compose.yaml for the Docker bridge range.
//secrets: Jwt:Key, ConnectionStrings:Default, SuperAdmin:Email and SuperAdmin:Password are
deliberately absent from this file, because this file is committed. Set them in
.env (see .env.example) or in the environment. Start-up fails on a missing Jwt:Key.
//Email: Provider Log writes messages to the application log and delivers nothing. Set it to Smtp
with a Host, Port and FromAddress to deliver for real; Username/Password are secrets and
belong in .env, never here. Works with any SMTP relay -- an on-premises server, Gmail,
Brevo, SendGrid. Port 587 uses STARTTLS; 465 needs UseSslOnConnect=true.
//Observability: Metrics are counters and timings scraped continuously from MetricsPath -- they answer 'is
the system healthy'. Traces follow one request through the app and its SQL -- they answer
'why did THIS request fail or take four seconds'. Traces are collected in process either
way, so the trace id in an error response is always real; set OtlpEndpoint to ship them to
a collector (Jaeger, Tempo, Grafana, Azure Monitor) once there is one.
